//: WARNING, 2026-08-10: the deployed service does NOT use this file. Dashboard settings override it — builder RAILPACK rather than NIXPACKS, and a preDeployCommand of `npm run db:seed:deploy` instead of the startCommand below. That override caused five consecutive failed deploys: the pre-deploy seed ran a Prisma client aware of new columns against a database no migration had touched, and died with P2022 before the server started. Fix it in the Railway dashboard, not here — set the pre-deploy command to `npm run db:deploy && npm run db:constraints`, and do not let seeding gate a deploy. See the Deploying section of README.md.

build.//: No npm ci here. Nixpacks installs dependencies in an earlier layer and mounts a build cache at node_modules/.cache; a second npm ci tries to remove node_modules and fails with EBUSY on that mount.
build.buildCommand: npm run db:generate && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:constraints && npm start
